<translated_code>
#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <cstring>
#include <stack>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <unordered_set>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

static const int MAXN = 61;

class Test {
public:
    int R, C;
    long long binom[MAXN][MAXN];
    int cntA[MAXN], cntB[MAXN];
    long long best = LLONG_MAX;
    string s;
    unordered_map<long long, long long> memo;
    unordered_set<long long> visited;

    void start() {
        readInput();
        int maxN = 2 * (R + C);
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxN; i++) {
            binom[i][0] = binom[i][i] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++)
                binom[i][j] = binom[i-1][j-1] + binom[i-1][j];
        }
        long long x = 0, y = 0;
        int v1 = R + C, v2 = R + C;
        while (v1 >= R && v2 >= R) {
            if (x > y) {
                long long cur = binom[v1][R] - binom[v1-1][R];
                long long other = binom[v2][R];
                y += cur * other;
                v1--;
            } else {
                long long cur = binom[v2][R] - binom[v2-1][R];
                long long other = binom[v1][R];
                x += cur * other;
                v2--;
            }
        }
        best = llabs(x - y);
        dfsIter(0, 0, R + C, R + C);
        getline(cin, s);
        for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (R + C); i++) {
            cntA[i+1] = cntA[i] + (s[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            cntB[i+1] = cntB[i] + (s[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }
        long long ans = solve(0, 0, R + C, R + C);
        cout << ans << endl;
    }

private:
    void readInput() {
        string line;
        getline(cin, line);
        size_t pos = line.find(' ');
        R = stoi(line.substr(0, pos));
        C = stoi(line.substr(pos+1));
        // Read the string s later in start()
    }

    void dfsIter(long long x, long long y, int v1, int v2) {
        struct State {
            long long a, b;
            int i, j;
            int phase;
        };
        stack<State> st;
        st.push({x, y, v1, v2, 0});
        while (!st.empty()) {
            State cur = st.top(); st.pop();
            long long a = cur.a, b = cur.b;
            int i = cur.i, j = cur.j, phase = cur.phase;
            long long diff = llabs(a - b);
            if (best <= 1 || diff - binom[i][R] * binom[j][R] >= best) continue;
            if (i == R - 1 && j == R - 1) {
                if (diff < best) best = diff;
                continue;
            }
            long long key = a * 10000 + i * 100 + j;
            if (visited.count(key)) continue;
            if (phase == 0) {
                visited.insert(key);
                st.push({a, b, i, j, 1});
                if (i >= R) {
                    long long cur_val = binom[i][R] - binom[i-1][R];
                    long long other = binom[j][R];
                    st.push({a, b + cur_val * other, i-1, j, 0});
                }
                if (j >= R) {
                    long long cur_val = binom[j][R] - binom[j-1][R];
                    long long other = binom[i][R];
                    st.push({a + cur_val * other, b, i, j-1, 0});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    long long solve(long long x, long long y, int v1, int v2) {
        long long diff = llabs(x - y);
        if (diff - binom[v1][R] * binom[v2][R] > best) return 0;
        long long key = x * 10000 + v1 * 100 + v2;
        auto it = memo.find(key);
        if (it != memo.end()) return it->second;
        if (v1 < R || v2 < R) {
            if (v1 >= cntA[v1 + v2] && v2 >= cntB[v1 + v2]) {
                int sum = v1 + v2;
                v1 -= cntA[sum];
                v2 -= cntB[sum];
                return binom[v1 + v2][v1];
            }
            return 0;
        }
        long long ans = 0;
        char c = s[v1 + v2 - 1];
        if (c != 'B') {
            long long cur = binom[v1][R] - binom[v1-1][R];
            long long other = binom[v2][R];
            ans += solve(x, y + cur * other, v1-1, v2);
        }
        if (c != 'A') {
            long long cur = binom[v2][R] - binom[v2-1][R];
            long long other = binom[v1][R];
            ans += solve(x + cur * other, y, v1, v2-1);
        }
        memo[key] = ans;
        return ans;
    }
};

int main() {
    Test test;
    test.start();
    return 0;
}
